items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Wendell and then the other bass player, he's from home too, Paul Chambers.

ctx.x: And so I told Cannonball, I said, "Now, you just wait right here, and as soon as we finish you'll get your check, you and Nat." So when we were finished, Ozzie said, -- I said, "Ozzie, where's the check for Cannon and Nat." So he says, "Right here. Right here." So I says, "Okay, here you are." They looked at the check and they looked at me and they said, "Oh, man, this is -- oh, Klook, you're so beautiful." And so we went through all that. So, about -- well, we recorded, you know, with Hank, and then we had --…
